name: Cheap Tour to Cairo and Hurghada
description: Are you seeking to spend Cheap Holidays to Egypt, Ibis Egypt Tours achieved your dream by offering Egypt Budget Tours to Cairo and Hurghada, Enjoy the majestic atmosphere in Cairo moreover get the chance to explore stunning beaches at Hurghada and more with Cairo and Hurghada Cheap Tours.
overview: Are you seeking to spend Cheap Holidays to Egypt, Ibis Egypt Tours achieved your dream by offering Egypt Budget Tours to Cairo and Hurghada, Enjoy the majestic atmosphere in Cairo moreover get the chance to explore stunning beaches at Hurghada and more with Cairo and Hurghada Cheap Tours.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo airport, Ibis Egypt tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, at the end of your day tour back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada by air-conditioned bus, arrive Hurghada, check in, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling. Overnight in Hurghada Meals: Breakfast, Dinner

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Hurghada, optional excursion to tuck into spectacular islands like Mahmya and Giftun Island, plenty of water activities are waiting for you, swimming, diving or snorkeling are available. Overnight in Hurghada Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, Then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Hurghada bus station, drive back towards Cairo by bus, once you arrive Cairo bus station, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure. Meals: Brekfast

inclusions: Meet at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned Van
Accommodation for 03 Nights in Cairo at 03 stars Hotel including breakfast & all taxes
Accommodation for 02 Nights in Hurghada at 03 stars Hotel including Breakfast & all taxes
Cairo day Tour as mentioned at the above Itinerary.
Entrance fees to the above mentioned sites
All Transfers in Cairo & Hurghada by air – conditioned Van
transfer to Cairo International airport for final departure
VIP Bus Ticket Cairo / Hurghada / Cairo
